messages:
Maya: Ran into intermittent TLS handshake failures for edge proxies in ap-southeast-1 after the keystore role update at ~09:10. Error: 'tls: no suitable certificate' on backend connections. Anyone else seeing this?

ops-bot: Keystore role-change deployed by Jen at 09:07 — role: `proxy-keystore-reader` added to service-account: `redwood-edge-proxy` :gear:

Sriram: I saw some 502 spikes, correlates with that timeframe. Logs show 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority' for internal mTLS.

Dena: Are proxies still fetching certs from KMS-backed keystore or falling back to local disk? We changed RBAC so instances use instance-role instead of node-role.

Maya: Checked node: `/etc/redwood/keystore` symlink points to `/var/run/keystore/cache` but empty TTL. `journalctl -u redwood-proxy | tail -n 50` shows repeated 'keystore: fetch failed 403: access denied'

Sriram: ```
$ curl -s -H "Metadata-Flavor: AWS" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/info
{ "InstanceProfileArn": "arn:aws:iam::...:instance-profile/redwood-edge" }
$ aws sts get-caller-identity --profile edge-role
An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the GetCallerIdentity operation: Access denied
```

Jen: I pushed an RBAC tweak to the keystore role bindings two commits ago to tighten permissions. Possibly over-locked `s3:GetObject` and `kms:Decrypt`. Reverting now.

Harish: If `kms:Decrypt` is missing, the keystore agent will refuse cached keys — causing handshake failures. Suggest quick mitigation: allow `s3:GetObject` to `keystore-bucket` and `kms:Decrypt` on `alias/redwood-keystore` for role `redwood-edge-proxy`.

Dena: While we revert, can we enable proxy fallback to local cert store? There's a flag `--insecure-fallback=true` but it's dangerous. We could enable it in canary for single AZ.

Maya: I tested enabling fallback in canary but saw certificate mismatch errors with upstream cert names. We should avoid wide enable. Action list: 1) Jen revert RBAC, 2) Harish validate kms policy, 3) Dena roll canary with fallback off by default but with `--diag-mode` to dump keystore responses.

Jen: Reverted RBAC in IAM console. Change id: iam-change-2026-03-20-09. Updated policies to include `kms:Decrypt` on resource `arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456:alias/redwood-keystore` and `s3:GetObject` on keystore bucket. Patching now.

kms-bot: `kms:Decrypt` succeeded for instance i-0abcde at 09:17:08. Keystore agent fetched cert `cert-20260320-09:17` and wrote to `/var/run/keystore/cache/edge-proxy.pem` :white_check_mark:

Sriram: After revert, errors dropped to baseline. 502s reduced. We should add an alert rule: keystore fetch 4xx > 5/min. Also add a test in deployment pipeline to verify keystore IAM before RBAC promotions.

Maya: Filed incident ticket INC-2026-0319 with postmortem template. Next steps: create cross-region IAM validation runbook, add automation to verify `kms:Decrypt` and `s3:GetObject` for any role changes, and add canary policy to allow fallback with strict logging. Assign: Jen (fix IAM), Harish (policy review), Dena (canary).

Jen: :thumbsup: will follow up with PR for automated IAM smoke tests.
